lines.text: Saul becomes king at thirty, keeps two thousand men at Michmash, and Jonathan attacks the Philistine outpost at Geba.
The Philistines camp at Michmash with three thousand chariots, and Israel's men hide in caves while Saul stays at Gilgal.
Saul waits seven days for Samuel, then offers the burnt offering himself just before Samuel arrives at Gilgal.
Samuel tells Saul he acted foolishly, and the LORD has sought a man from Saul's own house.

wrong_details.wrong: a man from Saul's own house
wrong_details.true: a man after His own heart

lines.text: Saul counts about two thousand men, and on the day of battle only Saul and Jonathan have a sword or spear.
